steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: "My voice is always right. You should listen to me. What I tell you is good."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: "Inferior, clumsy, ugly, awful..."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: "That's what you all are. Don't question anything, don't doubt anything. If it exists, then it's justified. The loudest voice is always correct."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: "Discard the wrong ideas. Repeat the most beautiful words, just like me..."
Yes, don't stop. Keep walking and talking!
You chant along with them to the radio without stopping. Seeing this, the strange figures finally stop staring at you and leave you alone.
Just like that, a petite girl leads you hand in hand to a place where the lights aren't so bright.
Phew... That was terrifying!
I thought we were both going to die back there!
The petite girl lets go of you and pats her chest dramatically.
Hey, say something. Say, how much wood could a woodchuck chuck if a woodchuck could chuck wood...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why would I say that... are... you really a normal person?
Of course I'm normal!! Look at my head!
See? I'm a human, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well... you seem to be.
Uh... wait, how did you adapt so quickly?!
I broke down for an hour before I finally got it...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Maybe it's because of my job...
You quietly shift your gaze away with a somewhat awkward look on your face. The sweet mirages, the terrifying art museum, the world of movies... you're indeed used to situations like this.
Though if it were up to you, you'd rather not be.
The petite girl seems triggered by your calmness. She starts running around, mumbling nonstop.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Um... calm down. What's going on?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I need your... assistance in my investigation. Please answer me truthfully.

You stop the pacing girl and pull out your work badge from your pocket. It's the pass the Public Security Bureau gave you when you went to the meeting in the morning. It has a picture of you taken when you registered at the entrance.
You were yawning the moment the picture was taken. Who knew the shutter would click at that exact moment!
Fortunately, the back of the pass has a large seal from the Public Security Bureau that's enough to intimidate anyone.
The girl is startled after seeing your credentials. After looking around and seeing that there is no way out, she obediently goes to your side.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Name?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Nino...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Age?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What landed you here?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: No!! I didn't do anything! I'm not here because I did something wrong!!
Nino stomps her foot, puffing up like an angry guinea pig.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sorry, sorry... I misspoke...
You put away your work ID and take a longer look at Nino. Her reaction is normal. Even though she's likely a handful, she's still a "normal person" who got dragged into this like you did.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: You're a cop, aren't you?! Then hurry up and help me get out of this hellhole! Isn't it your job to help people in need?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: If I don't get out of here soon, I'm gonna turn into one of those... those freaks!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Calm down. Tell me everything, and we'll find a solution together.
Nino pulls you to sit on a flower bed by the street, facing away from the strange people.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I was live streaming when I suddenly got summoned... Or should I say transported... Anyway, that's the gist of it!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Have you heard of Ghost Calls? All Eastsiders should know, right?! Call at 3 AM! That dirty show!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, I just found out about it today.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Actually, that radio station has been popular for a while. It's a well-known late-night station in Eastside. The hostess is gentle and has a pleasant voice, like a soothing night breeze...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: But it really blew up after they started talking about those Ghost Calls!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I'm a virtual host. When I was live streaming today, I really got a ******* call at 3 a.m.!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: My audience had been egging me on to call the radio station. They were being really generous with their donations. How could I not make a call for my fans?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Who would've thought, just two days later, the Ghost Call from 3 a.m. actually called me back!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So you took a call and then... ended up here?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Yes! How... How did you know?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Hmm, this is a serious matter!

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: ...Hey, do you know what the voice said on the phone?
Nino suddenly lowers her voice, whispering into your ear.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What did the voice say?
You recall the call you received in the phone booth. Your memory is a bit fuzzy, but you vaguely remember a gentle yet eerie voice telling you that she likes your voice and wants you to protect it.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: It was a female ghost on the phone... She said she loves my voice and wants to keep it forever...!
Nino's words are shaky and her voice is faint. Her breath tickles your ear.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Take away your voice...? How would she do that?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: You were surrounded by that group of people just now, right? When I first arrived, I also got surrounded.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: How could I let her take my voice? But I was so scared that I chanted along with them. As I chanted, I felt my consciousness becoming hazy, and my throat felt blocked. It felt like I wanted to say something but couldn't.
Nino touches her neck with her hand. Her dramatic face suddenly becomes tightly wound up.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Afterwards, I really didn't want to chant with them anymore. I wanted to stop, but found that I couldn't...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Your voice was taken away?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Yeah. I found that I couldn't say "no" at all.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I was terrified, so I ran away, chanting those phrases as I ran...

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Perhaps because I kept chanting, those guys with weird heads didn't chase after me... I ran all the way here, and when I took a break, I saw... I saw...
Nino's voice trails off, but you still hear the tremor in her voice.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I saw... My reflection in a window on the street...
Nino takes a deep breath and looks at you.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: In the reflection... My head was a computer with a red switch... The switch was my eye, glowing red, looking back at me.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I had turned into one of those... those people who only have one voice...
Nino covers her face, showing a terrified expression.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: That reflection scared me. I instinctively shouted no... I didn't want to be like this.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: I don't know if it was the scream that woke me up, but it seemed like... I changed back again. I found that I could say "no" again!
The people on the street begin to thin out. The streetlights shine on you, reflecting off the shop windows.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Mister, do you think... she will call us again?
steps.female_content: Miss, do you think... she will call us again?

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Does she... really want to take and keep our voices? To turn us into... those people?
You can't help but look up. In the reflection, you and Nino are standing side by side, both very real... Does the word "no" and the act of refusal have something to do with this world?
But the next second, a sudden ring in your ears breaks the silence!!
Ting-a-ling... ting-a-ling...
Nino grabs your sleeve. Her grip tightens around your wrist, and your pulse becomes noticeably faster.
You look around. There are no phone booths, but the harsh ringing continues.
